visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young adults sit at a light-colored wooden table against a plain gray wall. The middle male has wavy hair and a multi-colored cardigan; the left male wears a blue shirt; the right female is in a beige top. (2) A brown paper bag with 'Kentucky Fried Chicken' branding is brought into the frame. The man in the middle reaches in, his face bright with anticipation while the others look on. (3) A close-up shot reveals a thick burger with two layers of fried chicken and a golden-brown hash brown, glistening with melted cheese and red sauce, nestled inside a red-and-white cardboard box. (4) The trio examines the food; the man holds it up to show the camera its greasy, breadless layers. The girl prepares to take a bite, her facial muscles tensed in effort. (5) In a bright indoor kitchen with wooden shelves and appliances, the girl takes round sesame burger buns and places the chicken burger contents into them, pressing it together with her hands. (6) Back at the original setting, the man takes a massive bite of the newly bunned burger, his eyes widening and mouth full, showing a high-arousal expression of satisfaction.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A humorous food review where a group of friends tries a bunless fried chicken burger from KFC. They discover it is delicious but physically difficult to eat, leading them to 'hack' the meal by buying separate buns to reassemble it into a traditional burger, ultimately finding it more satisfying.
